1. Peraturan-peraturan ini bolehlah dinamakan Peraturan-Peraturan

Pendidikan (Penggal Institusi Pendidikan Tahun 2013) 2012.

Pemakaian

2. Peraturan-Peraturan ini terpakai bagi kehadiran di institusi pendidikan bagi

tahun 2013.

Tempoh penggal institusi pendidikan

3. Tempoh penggal bagi institusi pendidikan bagi tahun 2013 adalah sebagaimana

yang dinyatakan dalam Jadual.

EDUCATION ACT 1996

EDUCATION (TERMS OF EDUCATIONAL

INSTITUTIONS YEAR 2013) REGULATIONS 2012

IN exercise of the powers conferred by paragraph 130(2)(b) of the Education Act 1996

[Act 550], the Minister makes the following regulations:

Citation

1. These regulations may be cited as the Education (Terms of Educational

Institutions Year 2013) Regulations 2012.

Application

2. These Regulations shall apply to attendance at educational institutions for the

year 2013.

Duration of terms of educational institutions

3. The duration of terms of educational institutions for the year 2013 shall be as

specified in the Schedule.
